Jordan / team —

Attaching the redacted artifacts for Acme's review. Summary of the technical package below:
- Scope: external perimeter + control plane + hosted inference endpoints (same scope as agreed in testing SOW). No customer data stores were in scope.
- High-level findings: 3 medium-risk misconfigurations (network ACLs, TLS config), 1 low-risk informational finding. No critical findings.
- Fixed items: TLS config and two of the network ACL issues were remediated during the validation window.
- Outstanding: one network ACL that requires change window (ETA for remediation & retest: 2027-06-03).
- Retest plan: targeted retest for the outstanding ACL on 2027-06-04; excerpt from retest script included.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_pt_full_redacted.pdf (full report, redacted), remediation_slide_deck.xlsx (spreadsheet with per-finding status), retest_report_excerpt.pdf
